title: Turn meetings into deliverables with the Comu Action Pro
excerpt: This article is sponsored by Comu
content_html:
Attending meetings can be a grueling, though necessary, part of the daily grind. Whether you work in sales, consulting, or corporate leadership, the real work begins after the meetings end. Analyzing meeting notes can take up a lot of time: finding useful insights in the conversation, updating your customer relationship management system, sending follow-up emails, and more.

The tasks after a meeting can be the most time-consuming part of your day. But what if you could save a lot of that time?

That’s where Comu comes in with the Action Pro. It’s a small, portable AI recording and productivity device that can ease the headache of after-meeting tasks. After recording a conversation, this handy device can help generate CRM notes, follow-up emails, summaries, and more, so you can spend more time doing other tasks.

A pocket-sized device built for information-heavy workloads

Comu Action Pro

Brand
Comu

Battery Life
Up to 70 hours

Display
OLED display

Sound
Adaptive Six-Mic Capture

Colors
Black, Silver, Purple

The Comu Action Pro is an AI voice recorder and overall workmate that captures conversations with six adaptive microphones and automatically generates accurate transcripts, summaries, and actionable notes. With AI-powered tools for creating follow-up emails, task lists, and presentations, this portable meeting assistant helps professionals save time and turn conversations into productive next steps.

If your workdays are filled with team meetings, interviews, and client calls, the Comu Action Pro can help you streamline those conversations and move on to the important next steps.

With an intentionally straightforward design, you just need to press record to start documenting the conversation. Its slim build (measuring just 3.58 inches by 2.36 inches, with under a quarter-inch thickness) easily fits inside a pocket or attaches to the back of a phone when using the included magnetic ring attachment.

A 0.95-inch OLED display shows recording status, and you can also press the AI button on the device and speak a request to Comu AI, such as asking it to draft slides, documents, emails, and more.

A built-in AI assistant makes it easier to act on meeting conversations, with zero prompts required

While plenty of AI recorders have flooded the market, the Comu Action Pro takes AI recording to another level. It’s a productivity tool that takes your recordings and transforms speech into the next steps, whether you need a summary, a document draft, or an email. Through its dedicated AI button and the Comu app, you can turn your recorded conversation into a summary, a key decision list, an action items list, follow-up emails, CRM notes, calendar events, or presentation drafts. Best of all, the device’s AI button doesn’t require you to open the app to prompt any AI action; it’s merely one tap.

Speaker recognition, automatic speaker labeling, a custom vocabulary, calendar and task integrations, in-depth AI analysis, smart classification, AI Agent workflows (such as slide, document, and email creation), and real-time translation are other innovations that other AI workmates lack but Comu has. An update on the horizon will also include custom templates for your workflow.

And while other AI productivity software requires you to send lengthy prompts that usually need a couple of rounds of refinement, the device only requires talking to the AI assistant to tailor the conversation to your needs.

All these capabilities extend beyond merely saving an audio recording. With Comu Action Pro, you can turn conversations into actions and understanding.

Zero usage limits for basic recording, transcription, and summary features

While other AI recorders and AI notetakers charge for basic actions, placing a limit on your free usage, the Comu Action Pro provides unlimited recording, real-time AI transcription, and summary. No usage limits on these basic functions means you’ll never run out of recording, transcription, and summary needs when you have a week full of busy meetings on your roster.

The Comu Action Pro uses trusted AI models like GPT, Claude, Whisper, and Azure. Other features included in the basic Starter Plan are one-time real-time translation per month, 500 agent credits per month, and smart playback.

Adaptive 360-degree six-microphone array clearly captures every word

To ensure the utmost accuracy in every recording, the Comu Action Pro uses a six-microphone array that provides 360-degree coverage to accurately capture conversations, no matter where you’re recording from. Whether you’re in a packed meeting room, taking an important call on the subway, sitting with a client at a café, or even in a busy airport terminal, you can confidently press the record button.

The device includes integrated advanced AI algorithms to reduce background noise. To streamline your recording transcriptions, it also automatically distinguishes between speakers, so your transcriptions will have clear labels to follow the flow of multi-person conversations.

Up to 70-hour battery life for back-to-back meetings

If you’re regularly in back-to-back meetings, client calls, interviews, or other fast-paced workplace conversations, you don’t just want an AI recorder — you want one with long-lasting battery life.

While other AI recorders on the market generally have a battery life of up to 20 to 50 hours, the Comu Action Pro gets up to 70 hours. This means you can spend less time worrying about low power during extended hours or busy weeks full of meeting marathons.

You can easily check the OLED display’s battery life status to see when you need to top up, too.

Other helpful AI features include real-time translation and data protection

Designed to do more than simply provide transcriptions and summaries, the Comu Action Pro features other helpful features driven by its powerful AI. You can use the device for real-time translation and transcription of 113 languages, with optimized language for industry-specific terminology, so accuracy remains paramount.

Your files won’t look all jumbled in your app, either. Integrated AI automatically organizes your files by type and topic. Plus, the recorder conveniently records your phone calls for you when you use the magnetic phone attachment. A future update will also make it possible to record phone calls while using earbuds.

Best of all, you don’t need to worry about how Comu manages your data. Per the company’s Trust Center, your recordings stored on the Comu Actin Pro are encrypted (AES-256) and GDPR-certified. Any data stored in the cloud is also encrypted. Your data is never used to train AI models or used for the company’s advertising or profiling, and you can also delete any data associated with your account at any time. The Comu Action Pro also has CCPA, HIPAA, and SOC II compliance, so you can use the device with peace of mind.

Turn conversations into meaningful, actionable next steps

You’ll always have meetings, but with Comu Action Pro, the follow-up procedures after the meetings can be much more streamlined. The AI workmate is built for professionals who regularly attend meetings, create content based on those meetings, and require meticulous documentation of calls and beyond. Whether you’re a physician, lawyer, corporate executive, consultant, sales professional, researcher, professor, or just someone whose job requires high-volume note-taking, meeting minutes, and transcripts, the Comu Action Pro can help seamlessly capture important conversations and move on to the next steps without a hitch.

While transcriptions, summaries, and action lists can help you move forward with a game plan, documentation, emails, presentation drafts, and other AI-generated content from your meetings can save you time and start ticking off your to-do list.

Typically retailing for $256.99, you can purchase the Comu Action Pro today for 38% off and start making your meetings more efficient. There’s also an exclusive discount code: enter ANDMU10 at checkout to save an extra $10 and bring the cost to $159.99.
